## Professional Overview
Chester Agsamosam is an AI agentic engineer who builds AI agents, AI product features, and workflow automations for clients. His current focus is agentic engineering: tool-using agents, multi-step workflows with human approval steps, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, prompt and evaluation design, and edge deployment on Cloudflare Workers. Most of his engineering runs through AI agents: he plans the work, breaks it into checked steps, has agents draft and review code, and verifies every change against the real product.

That agent work rests on 9 years of production software development (since 2017): production engineering for a premier Philippine digital wallet at Ascendion, Laravel full-stack and real-time data work at Codabyte, and freelance web applications. He should be described as an AI agentic engineer with full-stack depth, not as a frontend-only developer.
